title: fix(reporters): handle concurrent `createReport` calls
body:
### Description

Concurrent Vitest processes sharing a fresh report directory can both pass the `existsSync()` check in `createReport()`. One then fails with `EEXIST` when creating `.vitest` or its scoped directory. With the default blob reporter, this can leave a shard without a report even when its tests passed. The blob reporter started using this helper in #10232.

This PR replaces the separate existence checks and directory creation calls with `mkdirSync(reportDir, { recursive: true })`, which creates the parent directory and tolerates directories created by another process.

Basically it's a rare race condition.
